name: How should homeowners prepare their space before trim installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare their space before trim installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your installation crew arrives, clear furniture at least three to four feet away from walls and remove fragile wall decor from the work area. If pets or children are in the home, plan to keep them away from work zones where power miter saws, pneumatic nailers, and long trim stock are in use. If you have chosen unprimed wood, decide in advance whether you plan to paint or stain the trim. Gathering clear inspiration photos or existing molding samples also ensures our carpentry team matches your preferred profiles and door heights accurately before materials are ordered.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture away from walls, remove hanging decor, secure pets, and confirm trim profiles and paint or stain preferences before work starts.
